card.name: Inside suicidality warning words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of split-up words, mostly the capitalized word SUICIDALITY or SUICIDAL in boxed warning headings. It also fires on a few split ordinary words like Lyme or eyebrow.

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: Inner pieces of SUICIDALITY or SUICIDAL in capitalized warning titles.
modes.example: WARNING: DEPRESSION AND SU<<IC>>IDALITY Tetrabenazine tablets

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Inner pieces of ordinary words broken into parts in web text.
modes.example: L<<yme>> disease is expressed in stages.

card.plain: It lights up partway through the word suicidality in capitalized boxed warning headings, and occasionally in other long words.
